answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1150 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the yarrow. The willow index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the plume queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
